summary: Vicore Pharma Holding AB filed a Form 6-K on August 21, 2026, containing its Q2 2026 interim report and related press release. The filing discloses routine quarterly financial results, pipeline updates, and corporate activities such as the commencement of a dual listing on Nasdaq Capital Market and a Chief Scientific Officer appointment. No mergers, acquisitions, tender offers, or other special-situation transactions are mentioned. This is a standard periodic report for a foreign private issuer, with no exceptional corporate event triggering classification under special situations.
